title: Run through a true input prefix
statement: Let $B$ be a language of Boolean strings, and let $x,w$ be Boolean strings. For any $j\le |x|$ such that every bit of $x$ at an index less than $j$ is true, if $j\le |w|$, then running the machine on the prefix of $w$ of length $j$ from its initial configuration on input $x$ yields the scan configuration at position $j$, with buffer equal to that same prefix.
hypotheses_covered: B is a language of Boolean strings
x and w are Boolean strings
all bits of x at indices less than j are true
